title: The asset Invoices tab lists the closed work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed, on asset 1, closed with a posting date of yesterday.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 is listed with status Closed and the "Internal" badge.
  • Total balance reads "No Charge".
  • Discount and Tax rate are empty.
  • The row is dated yesterday, the posting date, and has no actions.
  • The tab has no cost or hours columns.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S3-R6: “The asset Invoices tab lists the closed work order with status Closed, the badge, Total balance "No Charge" and Discount and Tax rate empty (rows on that tab have no actions). The customer's Invoices tab (the receivables ledger) does not list it; the customer's Work Orders tab does (S2-R10). GET /api/invoices/list leaves it out too (no screen uses it today). Customer statements, the customer balance and credit limit checks do not include it, and no message driven by an open balance can pick it up, since it carries none. The Finance tab menu of the closed work order offers Reopen Work Order only (S4-R1); Issue Credit is not shown, as there is nothing to credit.”
  • S9-R10: “The asset's Invoices tab lists the closed internal and no-charge work orders with the badge, Total balance "No Charge" and Discount and Tax rate empty, dated by the posting date, so the history per unit is there; cost and hours are in the NO CHARGE document (columns are v1.1).”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Cost per asset. v1 creates the data (one internal work order per asset with parts cost and hours, listed on the asset's Invoices tab) and does not build the per-asset cost report or add cost columns to that tab. v1.1, owned by the PM.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 1570 (TP-174): “reads "No Charge", and Discount and Tax rate are empty.”
